profile.headline: Software Engineer at Charles Schwab
profile.summary: Software Developer with over 4 years of experience designing, developing, and deploying scalable full-stack applications. Shipped enterprise-scale software across HR/payroll, telecommunications, and higher education organizations, owning projects from requirements through deployment, and driving operational efficiency through automation that saves organizations thousands of hours annually.

positions.title: Software Developer IV
positions.description:
Led the development of several automation features for the onboarding platform, serving 36,000+ client organizations ranging from small businesses to Fortune 500 enterprises, partnering with HR teams to eliminate thousands of hours of manual work per year.

Automated employee data flow across Applicant Tracking, Background Checks, and Onboarding modules, eliminating manual re-entry and cutting average HR processing time per new hire.

Implemented GitLab CI/CD pipelines to automate unit testing, lint checks, and deployment.

Streamlined the hire/rehire workflow, reducing manual PAF inputs and saving HR teams thousands of hours annually across the client base.

Collaborated with product managers and quality assurance team to deliver product specifications and translated cross-functional stakeholder and user feedback into clearly scoped engineering requirements, accelerating feature delivery cycles and reducing requirement ambiguity during development.

Mentored junior software developers through code reviews, technical guidance, and collaborative debugging sessions, improving development velocity, code quality, and adherence to engineering best practices across the team.

positions.title: Software Developer III
positions.description:
Led the development of a new onboarding email communications module, automating onboarding emails with a configurable scheduling system.

Architected and developed a distributed queue-worker platform, processing thousands of concurrent asynchronous email jobs, improving scalability and enabling real-time delivery of thousands of onboarding emails per month.

Deployed containerized microservices with RESTful APIs and built a dashboard for managing and scheduling onboarding communications, reducing manual email coordination time for HR teams.

positions.title: Software Developer II
positions.description:
Led the development of international onboarding workflows across five countries, dynamically rendering country-specific forms, streamlining the international onboarding process and reduced manual setup effort.

Designed database schemas and optimized query performance for high-traffic onboarding endpoints, improving average read response times.

positions.title: Application Developer
positions.description:
Developed full-stack web applications, scaled to be used daily by more than 47,000 students and faculty to register for courses, submit and access grades, and manage records.

Enhanced the student information dashboard and course marketplace, improving navigation, accessibility,
visual consistency, and improve performance by refactoring REST APIs, reducing page load times.

Optimized database schemas by rewriting joins, adding indexes, and introducing caching.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Accelerated customer support by releasing a customer approximate location indicator component on T-Mobile's 5G coverage map, speeding coverage diagnosis and reducing average call-handle time.

Published an internal Node.js library that standardized proof-of-possession token authorization across T-Mobile services, driving adoption across several engineering teams and saving hours of boilerplate setup.
